sites.name: Chichén Itzá and the Sacred Cenote
sites.what: INAH archaeological zone; the Sacred Cenote is inside the zone and visited on the general ticket.

access.tickets: INAH fee MXN 105 plus a Yucatán state fee (MXN 548 for foreigners)

lore.text: Popular theories claim the Maya calendar foretold the end of the world in 2012 and that the pyramid encodes alien knowledge.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source

sources.authority: Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia (INAH)
sources.title: Chichén Itzá (Lugares INAH)

sites.name: Yucatán cenotes
sites.what: Natural sinkholes regulated by the state cenote regulation: no tanning lotions, soaps or similar products from three hours before entering (biodegradable organic products excepted at bathing cenotes), shower first, and no smoking, eating, drinking, running, jumping, littering or damage.

underwater.diving: Cave and cavern diving only where the operator is authorised; details not yet checked
underwater.guide_or_permit: Tourist cenotes must have guides, signage and first aid; bathing cenotes lifeguards and life jackets

lore.text: Popular lore calls cenotes gateways to Xibalba, the Maya underworld.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source
